Experimental_Design.Conditions: 2 (personal prime: self vs stranger name) x 3 (emotional target: happy, neutral, sad) x 2 (match vs unmatch); 30 trials per condition

Block_Structure.Practice_trials: 12 (6 self-paced + 6 timed practice, identical structure to test trials); plus 6 demonstration trials with instructions and no prime (not counted)

Trial_Structure.Stimulus_duration: name prime 200 ms; shape-emotion pair 150 ms
Trial_Structure.Stimulus_order: Sequential: fixation, personal-name prime (own first name = self; stranger's chosen name = stranger) above fixation, 50 ms fixation, then simultaneous shape (above) and emotion-face image with circle outline (below)

Stimulus_Properties.Shape: geometric shapes: triangle (1.tif), diamond (2.tif), pentagon (3.tif); each shape first associated with one emotion category (happy/neutral/sad) during learning
Stimulus_Properties.Label: emotional face images: happy.tif, neutral.tif, sad.tif (schematic faces with circle outline)

Colors.Stimulus: white/grey screen; emotion-face images with surrounding circle outline; name primes in black text

exp2.detail: Experiment 2 of Lee, Martin & Sui (2026, BritJPsy, DOI 10.1111/bjop.70100): reverse priming direction. Participants first associated three geometric shapes with three emotions (happy/neutral/sad face images); in the test, personal name primes (participant's own first name = self; a name chosen for a stranger = stranger) preceded shape-emotion pairs. Task is a shape-emotion matching variant (no self-referential association in the pairings), coded in the database as Task=facialExpression-matching with extraIV1 = personal prime (self/stranger). NOTE (paper-data discrepancy, recorded for Verifying_original_results_issues): the paper Methods sentence states the non-self prime was 'the participant's best friend's first name', but the Inquisit script E3a.iqx and the data record the non-self prime as a STRANGER name (participants chose a name for an imagined stranger); the Introduction/Abstract/Figure 5 and OSF analysis code consistently describe the prime contrast as self vs stranger. Data were therefore coded self/stranger. Authors excluded 8 of the 50 complete participants from analyses for chance-level accuracy (mean ACC <=55%; excluded IDs: 18491, 49142931, 18689, 18541, 18365, 956227845, 560455705, 949712262) -> analysed N=42. One further logged session (463627897) quit partway (54 trials) and is not part of this dataset. Timeout trials are ACC=NA in this database (authors counted them as incorrect). RT_ms is Inquisit latency from pair onset. Data source: OSF enfma archive Data_files/E2_SSt_E_data (author-internal naming e3a, run by Inquisit script E3a.iqx; 50 participants x 360 trials = 18000 rows; matched author OSF_analysis.Rmd cleaning exactly).
